input_plan.query: Among Aircraft-primary reports that have both a pressurization, pack, bleed-air, or air-conditioning component record and a smoke, fumes, odor, or aircraft-equipment-problem event, how many distinct incidents are primarily attributable to equipment_malfunction, maintenance_or_release_decision, environmental_contamination, or crew_procedure? Include only reports with one clearly primary cause and an operational consequence beyond a maintenance-record entry. For each cause, summarize the canonical system and dominant operational outcome in at most six words each.

reference_semantic_plan.program:
causal_records := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, incidents.csv, [incident_id, text_file, primary_problem])
  -> FILTER(primary_problem = 'Aircraft')
  -> SCAN_DOCS(NASA_ASRS, selector=filtered_incidents.text_file, [incident_id, text])
  -> SEM_FILTER("Keep reports whose narrative states one clearly primary cause for the smoke, fumes, odor, or equipment event.", {text})
  -> SEM_FILTER("Keep reports that describe an operational response or consequence beyond a maintenance-record entry alone.", {text})
  -> SEM_EXTRACT("Extract the initiating condition, relevant system phrase, crew or maintenance intervention, and operational outcome as phrases of at most eight words.", {incident_id:string, initiating_condition:string, system_phrase:string, intervention:string, operational_outcome:string}, {incident_id,text})
  -> SEM_CLASSIFY("Assign primary cause to equipment_malfunction, maintenance_or_release_decision, environmental_contamination, or crew_procedure.", target_labels=[equipment_malfunction,maintenance_or_release_decision,environmental_contamination,crew_procedure], input_bindings={initiating_condition,system_phrase,intervention,operational_outcome,text})
)
component_records := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, components.csv, [incident_id, attribute, value])
  -> FILTER(attribute = 'aircraft_component' AND (value CONTAINS 'Pressurization' OR value CONTAINS 'Pack' OR value CONTAINS 'Bleed' OR value CONTAINS 'Air Conditioning'))
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {component_records:COLLECT(value)})
)
causes_with_components := JOIN(left=causal_records, right=component_records, join_type=inner, condition=causal_records.incident_id = component_records.incident_id)
event_labels := (
  SCAN_TABLE(NASA_ASRS, events.csv, [incident_id, event_type, label])
  -> FILTER(label = 'Flight Deck / Cabin / Aircraft Event Smoke / Fire / Fumes / Odor' OR label CONTAINS 'Aircraft Equipment Problem')
  -> GROUP_BY([incident_id], {event_labels:COLLECT(event_type,label)})
)
joined := JOIN(left=causes_with_components, right=event_labels, join_type=inner, condition=causes_with_components.incident_id = event_labels.incident_id)
joined
-> GROUP_BY([cause_category], {incident_count:COUNT_DISTINCT(incident_id), causal_records:COLLECT(system_phrase,operational_outcome,component_records,event_labels)})
-> SEM_AGGREGATE("For each cause category, produce the canonical system and dominant operational outcome as phrases of at most six words.", {canonical_system:string, dominant_operational_outcome:string}, group_by=[cause_category], input_bindings={causal_records})
